VECTRENCH

Describe a canyon in plain language. Fly it at five hundred units a second.
Tilt to steer · touch anywhere to shoot · fly the crosshair over targets to lock them, then launch.

CONTROLS & SETUP
motion: unknown
1.0
INVERT LEFT/RIGHT INVERT UP/DOWN
MUTE CRT GLOW
You do not aim. The marker rides the ship's nose, so steering swings it across the frame, and flying it across a target paints it; painted targets stay locked until you press MISSILES, and every lock is struck at once. Touching anywhere fires the gun, which overheats if you hold it.

Tilt neutral is however you are holding the phone when a run starts, taken as soon as you hold still. Use CALIBRATE TILT to re-take it.

No tilt sensor? Drag one finger to steer, and touch with a second to fire. On a desktop, arrow keys or WASD steer, click or SPACE fires, and SHIFT or M launches.
